messages:
Maria K.: Heads up — PR #6142 for the embeddings migration has a sample that CI flagged as sensitive in docs preview. https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/6142

docs-bot: docs preview failed: secret-detection found literal-like token 'customer_master_key' — CI details: https://ci.redwood/1234 :warning:

Jake R.: ah, I swapped out the real key last week but left the inline sample still showing 'customer_master_key'. my bad.

Maria K.: @Sasha (Legal) — can you advise redaction wording? We need this merged before Tue deploy window. If legal approves we can do a quick patch.

Sasha (Legal): please remove any real-looking key material. Replace with `<KMS_KEY_ID>` placeholder and add this sentence in the snippet comment: 'DO NOT COPY INTO PRODUCTION ENVIRONMENTS — use your own KMS key.' Also add a short note in the migration guide about key rotation and auditing.

Liam S.: also add a line about the secrets scanner: reference `docs/ops/secrets-scan.md` so security doesn't create an exemption. We prefer fixing examples rather than exemptions. I'll review scanner output after the update.

Carol D.: for the merge flow — label the PR `needs-legal` + `docs-review`. If legal signs off by EOD UTC I can finish docs QA and merge in tomorrow morning merge window.

Jake R.: pushing a tiny commit now that replaces the literal and adds the note. branch: `fix/embed-redact-6142`

Jake R.: ```python
# bad example (removed)
# kms_key = 'customer_master_key_abc123'

# fixed example
kms_key = '<KMS_KEY_ID>'
# NOTE: replace with your own KMS key; DO NOT COPY INTO PRODUCTION ENVIRONMENTS
```

Sasha (Legal): wording looks good. tiny nit: prefer 'do not copy into production environments' (already done) — after that :+1: from legal.

Maria K.: tagging release ops: @release-bot — please hold auto deploy until I confirm merged PR is green.

docs-bot: PR updated, docs preview queued: https://docs-preview.redwood/preview/6142 :rocket:

Carol D.: will run snippet tests and spellcheck once preview succeeds.

Sasha (Legal): Approved for publication on legal phrasing. You can merge once the preview is green. :white_check_mark:

Maria K.: merging after green. thanks everyone :tada:
